description_en: This topic describes the syntax and provides examples of the medical AI chat API operation RunMedQA
description_zh: 本文介绍医学智能问答RunMedQA的语法及示例
kebab_example: aliyun imageprocess run-med-qa --org-id 0001 --org-name weiyi --department '皮肤科' --question-type chiefComplaint --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunMedQA

parameters.help_en: The code of the data source organization
parameters.name: org_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the data source organization
parameters.name: org_name

parameters.help_en:
The session ID. You do not need to specify SessionId when sending the chief complaint for the first time. When QuestionType is set to `chiefComplaint`, it is considered the first consultation. The corresponding SessionId is returned in the response after the first call. SessionId is required for subsequent consultations. That is, when QuestionType is not `chiefComplaint`, this parameter is required.

A single consultation corresponds to one SessionId. A consultation consists of multiple rounds of conversation, and each round corresponds to the unique SessionId of the current consultation. The consultation is valid for 24 hours, after which the SessionId expires
parameters.help_zh:
会话ID。首次发送主诉信息时无需填写SessionId，当QuestionType为`chiefComplaint`时算首次问诊。首次调用后返回结果中显示对应SessionId，后续问诊时SessionId为必填项。即当QuestionType非`chiefComplaint`时，此项为必填项。

一次问诊对应一个SessionId，一次问诊会有多轮次对话，每个轮次都对应当前这个问诊的唯一SessionId。问诊有效期为24小时，24小时后SessionId失效
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en:
The hospital department.

The current service version supports only Dermatology
parameters.help_zh:
代表医院科室。

当前服务版本仅支持皮肤科
parameters.name: department

parameters.help_en:
The question type. Valid values:

chiefComplaint: chief complaint
age: age
bodyParts: body parts
symptoms: symptoms
complications: complications
diseaseCourse: disease course
diseaseHistory: disease history
medications: medication history
allegries: allergy history
images: skin lesion images
reports: report

For the first consultation, QuestionType cannot be empty and must be set to `images`. sessionId can be empty
parameters.help_zh:
问题类型。取值如下：

chiefComplaint：主诉
age：年龄
bodyParts：部位
symptoms：症状
complications：并发症
diseaseCourse：病程
diseaseHistory：疾病史
medications：用药史
allegries：过敏史
images：皮损图片
reports：报告

首次问诊，QuestionType不能为空，且必须为`images`类型，sessionId可为空
parameters.name: question_type

fields.help_en:
The URL of a skin disease image to be detected. A maximum of 50 URLs are supported. We recommend that you use Object Storage Service (OSS) URLs in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or the OSS URL is not in the Shanghai region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.

Required when QuestionType is set to `images`. Use either AnswerImageURL or AnswerImageData. When both are specified, the URL takes precedence. For information about Base64 encoding of files, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html
fields.help_zh:
待检测皮肤病图像的URL地址。最多支持添加50条。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。

当QuestionType为`images`时必填。AnswerImageURL和AnswerImageData建议二选一，当与Base64编码方式共存时，URL方式优先。文件的Base64编码处理操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html
fields.name: answer_image_url

parameters.help_en: The list of URLs of skin disease images to be detected. A maximum of 50 URLs are supported
parameters.help_zh: 待检测皮肤病图像的URL地址列表。最多支持添加50条
parameters.name: answer_image_url_list

fields.help_en:
The Base64-encoded string of a skin disease image to be detected. A maximum of 50 entries are supported. For information about Base64 encoding of files, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html.
Required when QuestionType is set to `images`. Use either AnswerImageURL or AnswerImageData. When both are specified, the URL takes precedence
fields.help_zh:
待检测皮肤病图像的Base64编码字符串。最多支持添加50条。文件的Base64编码处理操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html。
当QuestionType为`images`时必填。AnswerImageURL和AnswerImageData建议二选一，当与URL方式共存时，URL方式优先
fields.name: answer_image_data

parameters.help_en: The list of Base64-encoded strings of skin disease images to be detected. A maximum of 50 entries are supported. For information about Base64 encoding of files, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html
parameters.help_zh: 待检测皮肤病图像的Base64编码字符串列表。最多支持添加50条。文件的Base64编码处理操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html
parameters.name: answer_image_data_list

fields.example: 起了好多红疙瘩流脓，痒死了，晚上痒的最厉害，怎么办啊？
fields.help_en: The list of the patient's chief complaints or answers. A maximum of 50 entries are supported
fields.help_zh: 患者的主诉或回答列表。最多支持添加50条
fields.name: answer_text

parameters.help_en: The list of the patient's chief complaints or answers. A maximum of 50 entries are supported
parameters.help_zh: 患者的主诉或回答列表。最多支持添加50条
parameters.name: answer_text_list

AnswerType.description_en:
The option type. Default value: text. Valid values:

text: text
single: single-choice
multiple: multiple-choice
AnswerType.description_zh:
选项类型。默认为text。

text：文本
single：单选
multiple：多选

Options.description_en: The options for single-choice and multiple-choice questions. A value is returned when AnswerType is set to `single` or `multiple`. No value is returned when AnswerType is set to `text`
Options.description_zh: 单选和多选问题的选项。当AnswerType为`single`或`multiple`时有返回值，为`text`时无返回值

items.example: "发烧","呼吸困难","关节疼痛","腹泻","头痛","无"

Question.description_en: The supplementary follow-up question. No value is returned when QuestionType is set to `images`
Question.description_zh: 补充追问问题。当QuestionType为`images`时，无返回值
Question.example: 你好，还需要你补充些其他信息，年龄多大了？

additionalProperties.description_en:
预问诊信息结构化报表。
Reports中对应的key-value值如下表所示
additionalProperties.description_zh:
预问诊信息结构化报表。
Reports中对应的key-value值如下表所示
additionalProperties.example: "diagResults": [         "多形红斑",         "玫瑰糠疹",         "急性荨麻疹"       ],       "diagProb": {         "多形红斑": 0.992,         "急性荨麻疹": 0.0019,         "玫瑰糠疹": 0.0053       }

Reports.description_en: The structured pre-consultation report. A value is returned only when QuestionType is set to `images` (the last step of the consultation process)
Reports.description_zh: 预问诊信息结构化报表。当QuestionType为`images`时（即问诊流程最后一步），才有返回值
